[Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “他的妈妈觉得在墓地玩儿，害得，所以他们搬家。” Formula: Subject + 觉得 + someone/something + 会 + negative result + 所以 + result Correct: “孟子的妈妈觉得孟子在墓地玩儿会对他有不好的影响，所以他们搬家了。” “害得” needs a clear cause and result, such as “在墓地玩儿害得孟子学会了祭拜的动作.” Also, using “孟子的妈妈” is clearer than “他的妈妈” when introducing the character.

items.reason: “害得” lacks the required harmful-result clause, and “他的妈妈” is unclear when 孟子 has not yet been introduced.
